title: BGP session cycles Active/Idle — hold-timer too aggressive on R2
symptom: R2-R3 eBGP session briefly reaches Established then drops to Idle every 10-15 seconds. Logs show hold-timer expiry. The session never stays Established long enough to pass prefixes.

inject.note: Configures keepalive=3s and hold-time=10s. Any transient delay (CPU spike, interface queue) causes the hold timer to expire, tearing down the session. Peer is using default 60/180 timers.

ground_truth.root_cause: hold-timer too aggressive (10s) on R2 toward 192.0.2.2 — session resets on transient delay; increase hold-time to 90 or 180 seconds
ground_truth.verify: show ip bgp neighbors 192.0.2.2 shows Hold time = 90 and session stable
